page_title: HOF 1-0 LEV | Hoffenheim v Bayer Leverkusen 17/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+9' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) works the corner short.
90+8' A pass from Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by Oliver Baumann and the move breaks down.
90+5' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
90+5' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
90+4' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
90+2' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90+2' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bayer Leverkusen are going to take it.
90+1' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) for Tim Lemperle.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The attendance is 26957.
89' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
89' Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Janis Blaswich is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
88' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
86' The game is interrupted now, Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
86' Fouls committed – 16:5.
84' The game is interrupted. Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
81' Nathan Tella is substituted due to injury. Kasper Hjulmand gives a chance to Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen).
81' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
80' The injury to Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
79' Christian Ilzer prepares a substitution. Andrej Kramaric is replaced by Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim).
79' Substitution. Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) in, Alexander Prass out.

78' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Janis Blaswich pulls off a brilliant save. Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
77' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
77' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
76' A goal, which was scored by Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim), was disallowed due to offside.
75' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Janis Blaswich, who smothers the ball.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) comes onto the pitch so that Ernest Poku can be given a rest.
72' The move breaks down when Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) attempts an ambitious shot from distance that goes well wide of the right post.
71' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
70' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 15:6. The number of shots on goal at present is 6:2.
69' Christian Ilzer has decided to make a change. Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) replaces Fisnik Asllani.

68' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but Oliver Baumann dives superbly to deny him. His shot went towards the right side of the goal. Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar.
67' Rough tackle by Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
67' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
65' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
64' Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
63' Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
62' This is a yellow card! Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
62' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
60' Kasper Hjulmand is forced to make a change. Mark Flekken (Bayer Leverkusen) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Janis Blaswich.
59' Mark Flekken (Bayer Leverkusen) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
55' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
55' Mark Flekken (Bayer Leverkusen) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
53' Mark Flekken (Bayer Leverkusen) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

52' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Mark Flekken was alert and made an astonishing save! Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
51' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mark Flekken intercepts the ball.
51' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

50' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the roof of the net. However, Mark Flekken anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. Hoffenheim earn a corner.
49' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.
48' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) was quite harsh and Daniel Schlager didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
47' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen) comes off for Christian Kofane.
46' Kasper Hjulmand has made a change at the break. Ibrahim Maza has come on in place of Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Daniel Schlager has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

44' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball flies way wide of the left post as Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) produces an imprecise volley strike from long distance.

41' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Oliver Baumann is alert and denies him with a nice save.

40' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
39' It looked like the long-range shot by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
38' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
36' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) picks up a pass on the edge of the box and manages to get a powerful shot away, forcing the goalkeeper to scramble to his left and palm the ball away.
34' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) sprays a pass out to Vladimir Coufal, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
31' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
31' 3:1 – the total goal attempt statistics. The current number of shots on goal is 3:0.
30' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) plays a terrific long ball forward to Tim Lemperle, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
29' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
26' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
26' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Corner kick. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity.
24' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.

23' Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Patrik Schick, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
23' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
23' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
21' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) releases Patrik Schick with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball.
20' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
17' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen).
16' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner.
16' The percentage of ball possession is – 38:62.
15' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Mark Flekken.
15' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
14' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen). The ball is out of play and Bayer Leverkusen manage to earn a corner.
13' A pass by Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
12' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) is caught offside yet again.
12' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) picks out Ernest Poku with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
9' 1 - 0 Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) takes a wonderful free kick and curls the ball into the top left corner with an absolutely phenomenal strike!
8' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) is penalised for holding. Daniel Schlager signals a set piece. A free kick is awarded to Hoffenheim.
7' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. It's a throw-in for Hoffenheim.
5' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) offside.
5' Tim Lemperle received a clever long ball from Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert and managed to avert the threat.
4' The resulting corner from Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) comes to nothing.
3' A cross into the box from Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) is cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Hoffenheim.
1' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
